key_concepts: The 5Rs of waste management include reduce, reuse, recycle, recover, and repair.
Reuse means using an item again instead of throwing it away.
Recycle means making something new from old materials.
Recycling paper saves trees and reduces greenhouse gas emissions.
Recycling plastic bottles helps reduce pollution and protects the environment.
Recycling reduces the need for raw materials and preserves rainforests.
Recycling requires less energy and preserves natural resources for future generations.
Reusing containers such as jars and cartons saves money and helps the environment.
Recycling can turn waste materials like paper and plastic into cash.
Old magazines and newspapers can be recycled into picture frames and paper baskets.
Plastic bottles can be made into creative items like dolls or airplanes.
Some wastes, such as tissue and food peelings, are not suitable for recycling or reuse.
